properties.displayName: UAV S21 - Ground Segment Lateral Movement (impacket/crackmapexec Signatures)
properties.description: UAVLateralMove_CL에서 지상통제 세그먼트(GCS/C4I 호스트) 간 SMB/WMI 계열 공격 툴 시그니처(impacket-wmiexec, impacket-psexec, crackmapexec 등) 또는 NTLM-Relay/Guest 인증 사용을 탐지. 단일 SourceHost가 다수 PeerIp로 확산 시도 시 High로 상향. MITRE: T1570, T1021
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 15m;
let knownTools = dynamic(['impacket-wmiexec', 'impacket-psexec', 'impacket-smbexec', 'impacket-secretsdump', 'impacket-atexec', 'crackmapexec', 'evil-winrm']);
UAVLateralMove_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where ToolSignature in (knownTools) or AuthMethod in ('NTLM-Relay', 'Guest')
| summarize AttemptCount = count(), PeerCount = dcount(PeerIp), Tools = make_set(ToolSignature), Auths = make_set(AuthMethod), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by SourceHost
| extend TriggerReason = strcat('측면이동_툴시그니처_', tostring(Tools), '_대상수:', tostring(PeerCount))
| extend Severity = iff(PeerCount >= 3, 'High', 'Medium')
| project TimeGenerated = LastSeen, SourceHost, AttemptCount, PeerCount, Tools, Auths, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S21 - Ground Segment Lateral Movement (impacket/crackmapexec Signatures) - {{SourceHost}}
